label: represents
definition: A DigitalIdentity represents exactly one IdentitySubject in the model scope; a subject may have multiple digital identities.
derived_or_constraint: Inverse representedBy

label: interpretedIn
definition: A DigitalIdentity is interpreted within one IdentityContext.
derived_or_constraint: IdentityContext is not AdministrativeDomain/TrustDomain by default

label: hasIdentifier
definition: A DigitalIdentity may be referenced by one or more Identifiers; an Identifier may reference at most one DigitalIdentity in a given assertion scope.
derived_or_constraint: Do not infer subject identity solely from identifier equality

label: identifiesSubject
definition: An Identifier may identify an IdentitySubject directly within its scheme/scope.
derived_or_constraint: XOR/qualified coexistence with identifiesRepresentation is profile-sensitive

label: scopedBy
definition: An Identifier may be scoped by an IdentityContext.
derived_or_constraint: Scheme/namespace is datatype or profile mapping

label: about
definition: A Claim is about exactly one IdentitySubject at the proposition level.
derived_or_constraint: Credential may aggregate claims about multiple subjects separately

label: asserts
definition: A Claim may assert one or more IdentityAttributes.
derived_or_constraint: Claim may also carry proposition content not decomposed into attributes

label: assertedBy
definition: A Claim may record the Party that asserted/issued it.
derived_or_constraint: Issuer profile roles may specialize Party

label: supportsClaim
definition: Evidence may support one or more Claims and a Claim may be supported by multiple evidence items.
derived_or_constraint: Support does not imply truth

label: providedBy
definition: Evidence may have a providing/source Party.
derived_or_constraint: Source-system provenance may be profile metadata

label: derivedFrom
definition: Evidence may be derived from other evidence artifacts.
derived_or_constraint: Acyclicity should be checked in formal constraints where required

label: playsProofRoleIn
definition: Evidence playing the Proof role may participate in identity proofing.
derived_or_constraint: Proof is a role of Evidence, not a cryptographic superclass

label: mediatesSubject
definition: IdentityBinding existentially depends on and mediates one IdentitySubject.
derived_or_constraint: Relator mediation

label: bindsDigitalIdentity
definition: IdentityBinding may bind a subject to a DigitalIdentity.
derived_or_constraint: At least one bind target among DigitalIdentity/Credential/Authenticator is required

label: bindsCredential
definition: IdentityBinding may bind a subject to one or more Credentials.
derived_or_constraint: Relator mediation

label: bindsAuthenticator
definition: IdentityBinding may bind an Authenticator role-player to the represented subject/context.
derived_or_constraint: Does not make authenticator the subject

label: groundedBy
definition: IdentityBinding is grounded by one or more Evidence items.
derived_or_constraint: Evidence provenance required for high-assurance profiles

label: credentialAbout
definition: A Credential concerns one or more IdentitySubjects.
derived_or_constraint: Holder may differ from subject

label: carriesClaim
definition: A Credential carries or supports one or more Claims.
derived_or_constraint: Claim remains separate information object

label: credentialIssuedBy
definition: A Credential has exactly one issuing Party at the neutral Core level.
derived_or_constraint: P02/P04 may classify Party as Issuer role

label: hasCredentialStatus
definition: A Credential may bear a current CredentialStatus mode.
derived_or_constraint: History reconstructed from lifecycle events/status assertions

label: affectsCredential
definition: Each CredentialLifecycleEvent affects a Credential.
derived_or_constraint: Subevents include issuance/suspension/revocation/rotation in appropriate layers

label: producesCredential
definition: CredentialIssuance produces one or more Credentials.
derived_or_constraint: Issuance event may batch credentials

label: proofingSubject
definition: IdentityProofing concerns one IdentitySubject role occurrence.
derived_or_constraint: Proofed-person state is result/assessment not rigid Person subtype

label: usesEvidence
definition: IdentityProofing uses one or more Evidence items.
derived_or_constraint: Evidence types remain profile-specific

label: producesAssuranceAssessment
definition: Proofing may produce an assurance/confidence assessment.
derived_or_constraint: Assessment dimension must identify proofing

label: enrollsSubject
definition: Enrollment establishes managed participation/representation for an IdentitySubject.
derived_or_constraint: Not Provisioning

label: createsDigitalIdentity
definition: Enrollment may create one or more DigitalIdentity representations.
derived_or_constraint: Some enrollments update existing representation; cardinality is therefore optional

label: createsBinding
definition: Enrollment may establish one or more IdentityBindings.
derived_or_constraint: Binding may also arise through later lifecycle actions

label: performedBy
definition: Authentication is performed/initiated by a participating Party role occurrence.
derived_or_constraint: Actor may differ from represented/authorizing subject via Delegation

label: authenticatesSubject
definition: Authentication may target an IdentitySubject whose represented identity is being authenticated.
derived_or_constraint: Machine/federated cases may authenticate a principal/representation; profile mapping clarifies

label: usesAuthenticator
definition: Authentication uses one or more Authenticator role occurrences.
derived_or_constraint: Multiple authenticators support MFA

label: authenticationInContext
definition: Authentication may be associated with the identity-management context in which it is interpreted.
derived_or_constraint: Detailed authentication context class/assurance profile can specialize later

label: producesAuthenticationResult
definition: Each modeled Authentication produces one explicit AuthenticationResult record.
derived_or_constraint: Result record does not equal Session

label: hasAssuranceAssessment
definition: AuthenticationResult may reference assurance assessments.
derived_or_constraint: Assessment dimension must identify authentication when applicable

label: evaluatesRequest
definition: Each Authorization evaluation evaluates one AuthorizationRequest.
derived_or_constraint: Batch/multi-resource requests can be represented by multiple request items/profile structure

label: requestPrincipal
definition: An AuthorizationRequest has one Principal.
derived_or_constraint: Delegation can explain actor/authorizer distinction

label: requestResource
definition: An AuthorizationRequest targets one Resource at the Core request-item level.
derived_or_constraint: Profiles may aggregate resources

label: requestAction
definition: An AuthorizationRequest requests one Action specification at the Core request-item level.
derived_or_constraint: Profiles may aggregate actions

label: requestContext
definition: AuthorizationRequest may carry one AuthorizationContext situation/reference.
derived_or_constraint: Distinct from IdentityContext

label: producesAuthorizationResult
definition: Each modeled Authorization evaluation produces one AuthorizationResult/decision record.
derived_or_constraint: Decision value is data/enumeration in formal layer

label: permitsAction
definition: Permission normatively permits one or more Actions.
derived_or_constraint: Detailed conditions remain profile-level

label: permissionAppliesTo
definition: Permission may apply to one or more Resources/resource scopes.
derived_or_constraint: Abstract scopes may be profile constructs

label: grantPrincipal
definition: AccessGrant mediates one grantee Principal.
derived_or_constraint: Relator mediation

label: grantPermission
definition: AccessGrant mediates one or more Permissions.
derived_or_constraint: PermissionBundle is P01 mapping

label: grantScope
definition: AccessGrant may be scoped to Resources.
derived_or_constraint: Other scope dimensions may be profile data

label: delegator
definition: Delegation is grounded in an authorizing/delegating Principal.
derived_or_constraint: A Party may play the Principal role

label: delegatee
definition: Delegation mediates the delegated Principal/actor.
derived_or_constraint: Delegator and delegatee must not be same role occurrence for meaningful delegation

label: delegatedPermission
definition: Delegation may specify Permissions/actions granted to the delegatee.
derived_or_constraint: Scope may also be represented through AccessGrant relations

label: assessmentTarget
definition: An AssuranceAssessment may assess a proofing event/outcome.
derived_or_constraint: Other dimension-specific targets use parallel/profile relations

label: trustTarget
definition: TrustAssessment may concern a Party role occurrence.
derived_or_constraint: Profiles may also target Claim/Credential/Provider via qualified target pattern

label: trustSupportedBy
definition: TrustAssessment may be supported by Evidence.
derived_or_constraint: Trust does not reduce to evidence quantity

label: trustAlignsTo
definition: TrustAssessment may reference external trust concepts/framework alignments.
derived_or_constraint: External ONTrust relation remains external

label: reliesOn
definition: A RelyingParty may rely on Claims/identity information in an interaction.
derived_or_constraint: Profile may refine target to assertion/credential/authentication result

label: verifiesEvidence
definition: Generic Verifier role may verify Evidence; concrete verification semantics require specialization.
derived_or_constraint: Do not infer CredentialPresentationVerifier from any Verifier use
